flashcards.back: Data Engineering is the process of collecting, storing, transforming, and managing data. It plays a crucial role in supporting data-driven decision-making by providing a robust and scalable infrastructure for data storage, processing, and analysis. Data Engineers work closely with Data Scientists to design and implement data pipelines, ensuring that high-quality data is available for analysis and insights. Collecting data involves gathering data from various sources, such as databases, APIs, and files. Storing data requires designing and implementing data warehouses, data lakes, and other storage solutions. Transforming data involves cleaning, processing, and formatting data to make it suitable for analysis. Managing data involves ensuring data quality, security, and governance, as well as monitoring data pipelines for performance and scalability.
